questions.stem:
It is dark. Please turn on the light so we can see.
What does “turn on” mean here?

translation.stem: 天黑了。请开灯，让我们看得见。 这里“turn on”是什么意思？

questions.explanation: Here, “turn on” means “to start a machine, light or flow of water operating”.
questions.parentExplanation: 本题考查“turn on”在本句中的用法；正确英文解释为“to start a machine, light or flow of water operating”。对应源表释义为“启动，打开；打开；打开（水、电、电视、收音机等）”。

questions.stem:
Mia hears about the new library from her teacher and tells us the news.
What does “hears about” mean here?

translation.stem: 米娅从老师那里听说了新图书馆，并把消息告诉我们。 这里“hears about”是什么意思？

questions.explanation: Here, “hear about” means “to receive information about something”.
questions.parentExplanation: 本题考查“hear about”在本句中的用法；正确英文解释为“to receive information about something”。对应源表释义为“听说”。

questions.stem:
Please hurry up! The bus leaves in two minutes, and we are still at home.
What does “hurry up” mean here?

translation.stem: 请快点！公交车两分钟后就开，我们还在家里。 这里“hurry up”是什么意思？

questions.explanation: Here, “hurry up” means “to move or act more quickly”.
questions.parentExplanation: 本题考查“hurry up”在本句中的用法；正确英文解释为“to move or act more quickly”。对应源表释义为“赶快，急忙”。

questions.stem: The empty cup is in the way. Please t________.
questions.explanation: Put the pronoun it between take and away.
questions.parentExplanation: 代词it放在take与away之间，不能take away it。

translation.stem: 空杯子挡路了。请把它拿走。

wordHelp.meaning: remove one number or amount from another
a state of not understanding something clearly

questions.stem: The animal nurse t________ the injured rabbit until it can return to its owner.
questions.hint: Use the three-word phrase meaning looks after an animal and meets its needs.
questions.explanation: The singular subject “the animal nurse” takes “takes care of”, meaning looks after the rabbit.
questions.parentExplanation: the animal nurse为单数，用takes care of；指照料受伤的兔子。

translation.stem: 动物护理员照料受伤的兔子，直到它能回到主人身边。

questions.stem: Open your bag and t________ your book.
questions.hint: remove something from inside a place
questions.explanation: Take out before a noun means remove it from inside.
questions.parentExplanation: take out此处为取出，book是实际宾语。

translation.stem: 打开书包，拿出书。

questions.stem: Please t________ the classroom and put the books on the shelves.
questions.hint: make a place neat by putting things in order
questions.explanation: Tidy up means make a place neat.
questions.parentExplanation: tidy up后可接地点classroom。

translation.stem: 请整理教室，把书放在架子上。

questions.stem: The tap is still running. Please t________ to stop the water.
questions.hint: stop it from operating or flowing
questions.explanation: Put the pronoun it between turn and off.
questions.parentExplanation: it代指水龙头，置于turn与off之间；承接关水流。

translation.stem: 水龙头还开着。请关掉它，让水停下。

questions.stem: The tap is off. Please t________ to get some water.
questions.explanation: The pronoun it goes between turn and on.
questions.parentExplanation: 代词it放在turn与on之间，表示打开水龙头。

translation.stem: 水龙头关着。请打开它取水。

questions.stem: The ticket clerk says, 'H________ while I check your booking; this will only take a moment.'
questions.hint: Use the two-word request beginning with Hold that asks someone to wait briefly.
questions.explanation: The clerk needs a short wait to check the booking.
questions.parentExplanation: 请求短暂等候用Hold on；此处不涉及握住物品。

translation.stem: 售票员说：“请等一下，我查查你的预订；这只需要一会儿。”

questions.stem: At first, both clubs want the same room. I________, they agree to use it on different days.
questions.hint: Use the three-word phrase for the final result after a sequence of events.
questions.explanation: The agreement is the eventual result of the disagreement.
questions.parentExplanation: 争议后的最终结果用In the end，不是某物末端的at the end of。

translation.stem: 起初，两个社团都想用同一个房间。最后，他们同意在不同的日子使用。

questions.stem: What does “is good at” mean in this passage?
questions.explanation: Here “is good at” means “has skill in a particular activity”. The sentence says: Lily is good at describing places, so she writes the opening scene.
questions.parentExplanation: “is good at”在此处对应“擅长……”中的本句义项；句意为：莉莉擅长描写地点，所以她写开场。

translation.stem: 短文中的“is good at”是什么意思？

options.text: the first sentence of a story

questions.stem: What does “end” mean in this passage?
questions.explanation: Here “end” means “the way a story finishes”. The sentence says: I read both parts and suggest an end that brings the friends together again.
questions.parentExplanation: “end”在此处对应“结局”中的本句义项；句意为：我读过两部分，提出一个让朋友们重新相聚的结局。

translation.stem: 短文中的“end”是什么意思？

questions.assessmentTarget: 阅读细节、因果或信息整合
questions.stem: How does the group check that the parts connect?
questions.explanation: The answer is “They read the whole story aloud.”. Evidence: We read the whole piece aloud to check that each part connects clearly.
questions.parentExplanation: 正确项为“They read the whole story aloud.”。原文依据：我们大声通读整篇，检查各部分能否清楚衔接。

translation.stem: 小组怎样检查各部分衔接？

options.label: A
options.text: They send only the last sentence.

options.label: B
options.text: They read the whole story aloud.

options.label: D
options.text: They ask nobody to read it.

questions.stem: Which title is best?
questions.explanation: The answer is “Three Writers Build One Story Together”. Evidence: Our group is writing a short story for the class magazine. Lily is good at describing places, so she writes the opening scene. Ben enjoys making up problems for the characters to solve. I read both parts and suggest an end that brings the friends together again. The others agree that this final event matches the beginning of the story. We read the whole piece aloud to check that each part connects clearly. When we send it to the teacher, all three of us can see our ideas in it.
questions.parentExplanation: 正确项为“Three Writers Build One Story Together”。原文依据：我们小组正在为班级杂志写一个短故事。莉莉擅长描写地点，所以她写开场。本喜欢编出人物需要解决的难题。我读过两部分，提出一个让朋友们重新相聚的结局。其他人同意，这个最终事件与故事开头相呼应。我们大声通读整篇，检查各部分能否清楚衔接。交给老师时，我们三人都能在其中看到自己的想法。

translation.stem: 哪个标题最好？

options.label: B
options.text: A Group Draws a Map in Silence

options.label: D
options.text: Three Writers Build One Story Together

questions.stem: What does “rise” mean in this passage?
questions.explanation: Here “rise” means “move upwards”. The sentence says: We see the balloon rise slowly above the low garden wall.
questions.parentExplanation: “rise”在此处对应“上升”中的本句义项；句意为：我们看见气球慢慢升到矮花园墙上方。

translation.stem: 短文中的“rise”是什么意思？

questions.stem: What does “glad” mean in this passage?
questions.explanation: Here “glad” means “feeling pleased or happy”. The sentence says: We are glad that the bright balloon is easy to follow against the clear sky.
questions.parentExplanation: “glad”在此处对应“高兴的；愉快的”中的本句义项；句意为：我们很高兴，晴朗天空下，鲜艳气球很容易被看清。

translation.stem: 短文中的“glad”是什么意思？

questions.assessmentTarget: 阅读细节、因果或信息整合
questions.stem: Who keeps hold of the string?
questions.explanation: The answer is “The teacher.”. Evidence: The teacher keeps hold of the string while we step back safely.
questions.parentExplanation: 正确项为“The teacher.”。原文依据：我们安全地后退时，老师一直握着绳子。

translation.stem: 谁一直握着绳子？

questions.stem: What is the main idea?
questions.explanation: The answer is “A class observes and records a balloon's upward movement.”. Evidence: Our class watches a toy balloon tied to a long string outdoors. The teacher keeps hold of the string while we step back safely. We see the balloon rise slowly above the low garden wall. Lily records its movement in a drawing while Ben writes a short note. We are glad that the bright balloon is easy to follow against the clear sky. The teacher brings it down before we return to the classroom together. Our two records help us explain the movement to classmates who watched from indoors.
questions.parentExplanation: 正确项为“A class observes and records a balloon's upward movement.”。原文依据：我们班在户外观察一个系着长绳的玩具气球。我们安全地后退时，老师一直握着绳子。我们看见气球慢慢升到矮花园墙上方。莉莉画下它的移动，本写了一段简短记录。我们很高兴，晴朗天空下，鲜艳气球很容易被看清。老师把气球拉下来后，我们一起回教室。两份记录帮助我们向在室内观看的同学解释气球的移动。

translation.stem: 这篇短文的主旨是什么？
